name: OpenAI Self-Serve Fine-tuning
description: OpenAI is closing self-serve fine-tuning in three steps. Since May 7, 2026, organizations that had never fine-tuned can't start; since July 2, organizations with no fine-tuned inference in the previous 60 days are locked out; and from December 15, 2026 no organization can create new self-serve fine-tuning jobs. OpenAI had first set that final cutoff for January 6, 2027, then moved it three weeks earlier. Existing fine-tunes keep serving until their base model retires, and the six on legacy bases (ft-gpt-3.5-turbo, ft-gpt-4, ft-gpt-4.1-nano, ft-o4-mini, ft-babbage-002, ft-davinci-002) shut down October 23.

name: OpenAI Legacy GPT Image Models
description: OpenAI removes gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest from the API on December 1, 2026, months after this generation replaced DALL·E. gpt-image-1.5 only shipped on December 16, 2025, so it gets about 350 days. The models that buried DALL·E don't outlive it by much.

name: OpenAI GPT-5 (original snapshots), o3 & o3-pro
description: The original GPT-5 launch snapshots (gpt-5-2025-08-07 and its mini, nano and pro siblings) shut down December 11, along with o3 and o3-pro. GPT-5 launched in August 2025 as the 'PhD-level expert' model. Its launch snapshot gets 16 months before it starts returning errors.

name: OpenAI Realtime & Audio Model Family
description: OpenAI put its entire GA voice stack on death row: gpt-realtime, gpt-audio, gpt-realtime-mini, gpt-audio-mini and all four gpt-4o audio/realtime variants. gpt-realtime and gpt-audio went GA in August 2025, so the models that headlined 'production-ready voice agents' get roughly 17 months. OpenAI is skipping its own intermediate generation: the 1.5 series shipped in February 2026 and the named replacement is already 2.1.

name: OpenAI Whisper-1 & GPT-4o Transcribe
description: On August 26 OpenAI deprecated whisper-1 (its original speech-to-text API from March 2023) together with gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize, the last of which shipped in October 2025. All four die February 26, 2027. The open-source Whisper weights are unaffected; the hosted endpoint that made them a product is not.

name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
description: Anthropic's September 2025 coding model, billed at launch as the best in the world for agents and computer use, retires from the Claude API on November 30. Anthropic announced the retirement on the model's first birthday. Opus 4.5 is next: on November 23 Anthropic set its retirement for January 22, 2027.

name: OpenAI Agent Builder, Evals & Reusable Prompts
replacement: Agents SDK; Workspace Agents in ChatGPT; prompts in your own code; Promptfoo for evals
description: The visual agent canvas OpenAI introduced at DevDay 2025 as the centrepiece of AgentKit dies on November 30, along with the Evals platform and the /v1/prompts API. Evals goes read-only on October 31. Agent Builder lasted eight months in beta before its death was announced.

name: Reddit Public API (unregistered apps)
description: Reddit is closing its public API to everything but registered apps, saying RSS and open access had become 'a common surface for large-scale scraping and automated abuse'. New public API requests stopped on October 31, 2026, unregistered apps lose access on January 12, 2027, and the remaining public endpoints close that March. The RSS feeds went first: still answering on November 14, by November 18 Reddit's own feed server returned 'Not Found', and it still did on November 27. The data now goes to paying AI licensees instead; that revenue line grew 24% last quarter.

name: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Image ("Nano Banana")
description: The image model that went viral as 'Nano Banana' (3D figurine selfies, a #1 App Store spot for Gemini) got a stay of execution. Google's earliest shutdown date was October 2, 2026; a September 14 release note pushed it to no earlier than March 15, 2027, with gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image as the replacement. Since September 18 the Gemini API serves 2.5 models only to projects that used them before, though Google says they 'will continue to be served until further notice.'

name: Azure OpenAI GPT-4.1, 4.1 mini & 4.1 nano
description: GPT-4.1 launched April 2025 as OpenAI's 'best model for coding' with a 1M-token context window. Azure first scheduled the whole family to retire on October 14, 2026, then moved gpt-4.1 and gpt-4.1-mini to April 14, 2027. Nano's date flipped between the two several times; on October 14, the day it was due to go, Microsoft's schedule listed it for April 14, 2027 as well. All three are in the Deprecated stage (existing customers only), and fine-tuned deployments run until October 14, 2027.

name: Tencent QClaw
description: Tencent's take on the OpenClaw 'lobster' agent: an AI assistant driven from WeChat that operated your PC remotely, organizing files, running scheduled tasks and handling multi-step jobs. It opened to everyone on March 20, 2026, at the height of China's lobster craze. On September 24 Tencent stopped new sign-ups and renewals, citing 'business development adjustments'. Service ends at 00:00 on December 24 (Beijing time); users can still log in to download backups until March 24, 2027, when the data is deleted.

name: OpenAI Models in Cursor
replacement: Bring-your-own OpenAI API key or OpenAI's IDE extension; Claude and other models in Cursor
description: OpenAI is ending its contract to supply models to the AI code editor Cursor, using a change-of-ownership clause after SpaceX completed its $60B purchase of Cursor in August. 'It boils down to trust,' said OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux, citing Elon Musk's history of breaking contracts. OpenAI proposed November 12, 2026 as the cutoff, but that date was never confirmed by both companies: on November 27 Cursor's model list still carried 17 GPT models, pinned to the set it had in August. Once the cutoff lands, developers can still bring their own OpenAI API keys, and Cursor says OpenAI models were only about 5% of its traffic.

name: ChatGPT Custom GPTs
replacement: Plugins (ChatGPT + Codex); GPT instructions become a skill
description: Custom GPTs launched at DevDay in November 2023 and replaced ChatGPT Plugins. Now they are being replaced by plugins. OpenAI says they retire on December 11, 2026, though timing 'can vary by account and workspace'. Affected Enterprise workspaces lose GPT creation on October 26, and approved deferrals run to February 11, 2027. Instructions become a skill and knowledge files carry over; conversations, the chosen model, sharing settings and Custom Actions do not.

name: Gemini TTS Preview Models
description: Three text-to-speech previews leave the Gemini API no earlier than December 18: gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview, gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts and gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts. Google's deprecations table first said November 17, then moved the date a month with no changelog entry. The two Live API previews that shared the original date got longer reprieves: gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025 now runs to March 31, 2027, and gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview has no shutdown date at all. The 2.5 TTS models have been in preview since May 2025 and never left it. The replacements, gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts, were released on September 22.

name: Gemini 3.7 Flash (Vertex AI)
description: Released on Vertex AI on August 13, 2026 in Google's shorter-availability tier and scheduled to retire on January 28, 2027, 168 days later. Google never dated a notice; the date appeared in its model-versions table. The replacement is gemini-3.8-flash. Its predecessor, 3.6 Flash, was retired on November 19 after 121 days.

name: Azure OpenAI GPT-4o (2024-05-13)
replacement: gpt-5.6-sol (auto-upgrade on Standard deployments; Provisioned must migrate manually)
description: The original May 2024 GPT-4o snapshot retires from Azure on December 9, and Microsoft uses it as the worked example in its lifecycle docs. Global Standard, Data Zone Standard and Standard deployments are force-upgraded to gpt-5.6-sol. Provisioned deployments get no upgrade and must migrate by hand, and deployments set to NoAutoUpgrade start returning 410 Gone. It outlives OpenAI's own gpt-4o-2024-05-13, which goes on October 23, by seven weeks. The later 2024-08-06 and 2024-11-20 versions last until April 14, 2027.

name: Azure OpenAI Whisper & TTS
description: Azure retires version 001 of its whisper, tts and tts-hd models on December 15. That is weeks ahead of OpenAI, whose own API keeps tts-1 until January 6, 2027 and whisper-1 until February 26, 2027. Microsoft's policy is to declare a replacement 90 to 120 days before retirement, yet as of October the replacement column is still a dash. The March 2025 gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshots go first, on October 15.

name: OpenAI TTS-1, TTS-1-HD & GPT-4o mini TTS
description: On October 1 OpenAI deprecated its whole standalone text-to-speech line: tts-1 and tts-1-hd, launched at DevDay in November 2023, and both gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshots. All four leave the API on January 6, 2027. There is no new TTS model; the named replacement is the speech-to-speech gpt-realtime-2.1-mini. With whisper-1 going on February 26, 2027, every audio model OpenAI shipped in 2023 is now on a removal list.

name: Claude Opus 4.1 on Amazon Bedrock
replacement: None named by AWS (Anthropic recommends claude-opus-4-8)
description: Anthropic retired Opus 4.1 from its own API on August 5, 2026, but Amazon Bedrock keeps serving it until January 8, 2027 in us-east-1, us-east-2 and us-west-2, 156 days longer. AWS marked it Legacy on July 8: no new customers, and existing ones may lose access after 15 days of inactivity. From October 8 it is in 'public extended access', where the provider can raise the price.

name: Firebase Studio
description: Google's browser-based, Gemini-powered app builder absorbed Project IDX at its April 2025 launch and is being sunset before its second birthday. New workspaces and sign-ups were switched off on June 22, 2026. On March 22, 2027 the service shuts down and remaining data is 'permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.' Users are split between Google Antigravity for coding and Google AI Studio for prompt-to-app prototyping; Firestore, Auth and App Hosting are unaffected.

name: Pipedream Workflows & String
replacement: None (Pipedream Connect continues; JSON export for workflows)
description: Pipedream will shut down Workflows, its developer automation platform, and String, its prompt-to-agent builder, on March 31, 2027. All Workflows data, including stored credentials and OAuth tokens, is deleted by April 30. Workflows is already in maintenance mode, with sign-ups closed. The stated reason is a focus on 'being the integration layer companies rely on to connect AI to the outside world', and Pipedream Connect, with its API and MCP servers, carries on. Workday agreed to buy the company in November 2025.

name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service (classic)
replacement: New Foundry Agent Service (Responses API: threads become conversations, runs become responses)
description: Microsoft's managed agent service entered preview in December 2024 as Azure AI Agent Service and went GA in May 2025. In March 2026 it was renamed 'classic' and deprecated, through a notice added to the docs without a formal announcement. It retires March 31, 2027. Its threads-and-runs design was modelled on OpenAI's Assistants API, which died in August 2026. Migrating means rebuilding on the Responses API.

name: OpenAI GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.1 & GPT-5.4-nano
description: On October 1 OpenAI deprecated gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1 and gpt-5.4-nano, with removal from the API on April 1, 2027. gpt-6-sol replaces the first two and gpt-6-luna the third; both shipped nine days before the notice. gpt-5.4-nano launched March 17, 2026 and gets just over a year, although in April OpenAI was recommending it as the replacement for GPT-3.5 Turbo and the o-series. GitHub made GPT-5.3-Codex Copilot's first long-term-support model, promised through February 4, 2027.

name: Vertex AI Legacy Embedding Models
description: Four pre-Gemini embedding models retire from Vertex AI on April 1, 2027: multimodalembedding@001 (February 2024), text-embedding-004 and text-multilingual-embedding-002 (May 2024), and text-embedding-005 (November 2024). Google names no replacement. Vectors from different embedding models are not interchangeable, so every index built on these models has to be regenerated, not just pointed at a new model. text-embedding-004 already left the Gemini Developer API on January 14, 2026.

name: Amazon Q Developer (IDE plugins & subscriptions)
description: On April 30, 2027, three years to the day after general availability, AWS ends support for the Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins for VS Code, JetBrains, Eclipse and Visual Studio. Paid subscriptions and the Java and .NET code-transformation tools end the same day. New sign-ups stopped on May 15, 2026, and the newest coding models, including Opus 4.7, were made Kiro-only. Q Developer survives in the AWS Console, the mobile app, and Slack and Teams.

name: OpenAI GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 & 4.1 mini (API)
description: On October 14 OpenAI told developers that five snapshots leave the API on January 14, 2027: gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4o-2024-11-20, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 and gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14. Every one is pointed at the same replacement, gpt-6-luna, and fine-tuned versions go with their base models. GPT-4o mini was the default cheap model in thousands of apps; Azure keeps its own copies until April 14, 2027.

name: Google Jules
description: Google's asynchronous coding agent, which took a GitHub task, worked in a cloud VM and opened a pull request, entered beta in May 2025 and went GA that August. On October 29, 2026 Google said it is winding Jules down and folding the work into Antigravity. New tasks stop on November 11, when Jules turns read-only; it shuts down completely on December 31. Code already pushed to GitHub stays; session changes that were never pushed do not.

name: Mozilla Solo
replacement: None; export a ZIP of your site, domains move to Name.com
description: Mozilla's AI website builder for sole traders, launched in December 2023 as a 'Mozilla Innovation Project': describe your business and an LLM wrote and hosted the site. About 54,000 people built pages with it. It 'will cease operations on Nov 30, 2026', and every site and its data are deleted that day. Users get a ZIP with an HTML export and a CSV of image links; the images have to be downloaded one by one. Mozilla gave no reason beyond 'Sometimes, that means making the decision to bring a product to an end.'

name: Gemini 2.5 Pro & 2.5 Flash (Gemini API)
replacement: gemini-3.8-flash for 2.5 Pro, gemini-3.5-flash-lite for 2.5 Flash (requests are rerouted automatically)
description: Google's mid-2025 workhorses leave the Gemini API on December 1. Requests do not fail: calls to gemini-2.5-pro are rerouted to gemini-3.8-flash and calls to gemini-2.5-flash to gemini-3.5-flash-lite, so an app pinned to the old IDs keeps answering from a different model. Both went GA on June 17, 2025, and access had already been limited to existing users in September. Vertex AI retired the same models on October 20. gemini-2.5-flash-lite stays, with no shutdown date.

name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
replacement: gemini-omni-1.2-flash (requests are rerouted automatically, at its pricing)
description: Released on August 27, 2026 and rerouted 98 days later. From December 3, Gemini API requests to gemini-omni-1.1-flash are answered by gemini-omni-1.2-flash at the newer model's pricing. Google gave 28 days' notice, in a changelog entry dated November 5.

name: Claude Opus 4.5 (Claude API)
description: Anthropic's November 2025 flagship retires from the Claude API on January 22, 2027, 60 days after the November 23 notice, the minimum Anthropic promises. The retirement covers claude-opus-4-5-20251101 and the undated claude-opus-4-5 alias. Amazon Bedrock runs its own schedule: it marked Opus 4.5 Legacy the same day and keeps serving it until May 23, 2027.

name: OpenAI gpt-image-2
description: OpenAI's April 2026 image model, gpt-image-2 (snapshot gpt-image-2-2026-04-21), leaves the API on February 10, 2027, about ten months after release. Its replacements are the gpt-image-2.6 pair, sunburst and flare: the same two models the older gpt-image-1 generation is pointed to when it goes on December 1.

name: OpenAI GPT-5.5-Cyber Preview
replacement: Not named: OpenAI says 'the most capable cyber model available to you'
description: OpenAI's preview model for vetted security defenders, gpt-5.5-cyber-preview, leaves the API on February 1, 2027. The notice names no specific successor, only 'the most capable cyber model available to you.' Its predecessor, GPT-5.4-Cyber, is already in the graveyard.
